name: Trudr
source:
A former female thief, who is now trying to make her livelihood as a treasure hunter.
Having high strength and fighting skill, is capable of defeating monsters by herself.
While there is no sexual experience, has abundant knowledge regarding it because she was part of a bandit group.
Tries to pretend as someone who has plenty of sexual experience outside.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=963063]Getchu[/url]]
